title: Repair and Emergency Service Calls: Call Class Assignment and Moves Before Dispatch
content:
## 1. How the call class is fixed

1.1 The call class of a call under Repair and Emergency Service Calls is fixed by when the technician is booked to arrive, not by how urgent the caller feels it is. Each class runs only on its service days and within its service hours.

1.2 The classes follow from the booked window:

| Booked arrival | Call class |
|---|---|
| A weekday window between 08:00 and 17:00 booked by 17:00 on the prior business day | Standard Service Call |
| A weekday daytime window on the booking day itself, booked by 12:00 | Same-Day Priority Service Call |
| A weekday 17:00-22:00 window | Evening Service Call |
| A Saturday or Sunday daytime window | Weekend Service Call |
| Any 22:00-08:00 window | Overnight Emergency Service Call |
| Any window on a company holiday | Holiday Emergency Service Call |

1.3 The company holidays are New Year's Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day, Christmas Eve and Christmas Day. A window on one of these days is a Holiday Emergency Service Call, which overrides every other class. Every other class requires that the date is not a company holiday.

1.4 The window must be one of the class's arrival windows offered. The scheduled date must be no later than the class's furthest-ahead figure, in days after the booking date. A Same-Day Priority Service Call is scheduled for the booking date itself.

## 2. Bookable work and dispatch order

2.1 Paid precision tune-ups and duct cleaning are booked only in classes where they are bookable. Tank water heater calls are booked only where tank water heater repairs are booked in that class.

2.2 Where Comfort Club scheduling priority orders the queue, Comfort Club members are offered the earliest window first according to their tier's scheduling priority. Technicians of the class's technician pool are dispatched in window order toward the class's response target for no-heat and no-cool calls. No-heat and no-cool calls go ahead of other symptoms in the same window.

## 3. Moving a booked call

3.1 A booked call may be moved before dispatch. A call is reclassified only while its status is booked. The call's status is read from the call record.

3.2 The new class follows from the new window under the same rules as section 1.

3.3 Moving an after-hours or same-day call to a Standard Service Call is open only where the class allows a move to a Standard Service Call.

3.4 Each move counts against the class's free reschedules when the call keeps its class. A move made with less than the class's free-cancellation notice is handled under the cancellation terms for service calls.

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- A Thursday 12:00-17:00 window booked at 16:30 on Wednesday is a Standard Service Call. The same window booked at 09:00 on Thursday is a Same-Day Priority Service Call.
- A 08:00-12:00 window on Thanksgiving Day is a Holiday Emergency Service Call, even though it is a weekday daytime window.
- A call in dispatched status cannot be reclassified. A call in booked status can be.
